newsitem.title: USA: Missing Michigan schoolgirls found in Florida.
newsitem.headline: Missing Michigan schoolgirls found in Florida.

text.p: Two young sisters who disappeared last Friday after stepping off a school bus were found Tuesday morning in Daytona Beach, Florida, and three men were arrested on charges of kidnappaing them, the FBI said.

FBI Special Agent Thomas Bailey in Kalamazoo said Teresa Hainer, 9, and Jessica Hainer, 6, appeared to be safe and unhurt. Local police arrested three men -- acquaintances of the girls' father -- on federal kidnapping charges, Bailey said.
Bailey said it was not clear if additional charges would be filed against Ronald Stafford, 21, his brother Lee Stafford, 17, and Ricky Geer, all of the Galesburg area near Kalamazoo.

The FBI received a tip on a telephone hotline that the men were sighted with the girls in the Daytona area on Monday night, more than a day after they were seen in Gainesville, Florida, on Sunday afternoon.
The FBI and other law enforcement agencies waged a nationwide search for the girls after they stepped off a school bus in their hometown of Galesburg, Michigan.

They were supposed to go to a babysitter's home when they were dropped off at a trailer park, but instead got into a cream-coloured 1988 Pontiac 6000 station wagon with wood-grain side panels. Witnesses said the men stopped off at a gasoline station about a half-hour away from Galesburg with the girls and bought them candy and snacks and filled the car's tank and several auxiliary gas cans.
